card.name: Animal biology text before 'larva'-type words
card.fires_on: Words in zoology and bird or insect passages (hummingbirds, frogs, larvae) where the next word is likely to be a rare animal-anatomy term starting with 'lar' or similar. Includes words like 'whose', 'broad', 'annual' and 'against'.

modes.label: Before larvae
modes.description: Linking word in insect text where 'larvae' is expected next.

modes.label: Hummingbird names
modes.description: Parts of bird names such as broad-tailed or white-eared hummingbird.

card.writes: It nudges output toward words starting with 'lar' or 'breast' and away from words starting with 'h'.
card.plain: It fires in nature writing about birds, frogs and insects, where a specialist animal term is likely to come next.
